reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset and Brown split the chapiter into a plain lower tier Kings omits and a carved upper tier it alone records, reconciling both totals.

sides.snippet: the height of the capital was three cubits
sides.verseText: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of brass was on it; and the height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital round about, all of brass: and like to these had the second pillar with network.

sides.snippet: the height of the one capital was five cubits
sides.verseText: A capital of brass was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital round about, all of brass: and the second pillar also had like these, and pomegranates.
